targets.authors: Dawson DA, Grant BF, Li TK.
targets.title: Impact of age at first drink on stress-reactive drinking.
targets.evidence_quote: The primary goal of our study was to attempt to replicate Dawson and colleagues’ (2007) finding of drinking onset as a moderator of the association between SLE and alcohol consumption.
targets.outcome_quote: We confirmed prior findings of an association between early age at drinking onset with higher past-year drinking among young- and middle-aged adults and found limited evidence supporting a replication for higher stress-related drinking among early-onset drinkers.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors describe limited support for the targeted interaction and confirm the onset main effect. Weak evidence and smaller explained variance alone do not imply mixed; no overall failure verdict is given.

reasoning: A distinct population-based twin sample tests the published Dawson et al. finding; other cited studies supply background or extensions rather than additional direct targets.
